description: Defines network interface structures, enums, and functions related to network interfaces, IP address attributes, WiFi details, and network policies within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: NetworkInterface
classes.description: Represents a network interface with properties like name, address, type, and MAC address.

classes.name: ScopedWifiOptions
classes.description: Manages temporary WiFi options with automatic cleanup.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of network interfaces based on the specified policy.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Returns the SSID of the current WiFi access point, if available.

methods.name: GetWifiPHYLayerProtocol
methods.description: Returns the physical layer protocol of the connected WiFi network.

methods.name: SetWifiOptions
methods.description: Sets temporary WiFi options on all interfaces.

methods.name: GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the current system.
